processes:task-pv-operate-intake-29xxsy.plain_language_name: Take In the Catalogue and Channel States Feeding the Integrity Watch
processes:task-pv-operate-intake-29xxsy.plain_language_description: The watching over the buyable offering catalogue opens as its material arrives, chiefly the current catalogue state and the states of the selling channels. The intake custodian logs them against the integrity watch file so the monitoring starts accounted for.
processes:task-pv-operate-intake-29xxsy.business_purpose: It exists so every arrival bearing on catalogue correctness is on the books before the watch begins, leaving no unexamined state behind.
processes:task-pv-operate-intake-29xxsy.practical_context: It opens when the catalogue state and the channel states are presented for the integrity watch, with the activity's owner told that it has landed, and it closes with the intake registered and the later phases free to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in product management receives the day's catalogue state alongside the shop-front channel states, logs them into the integrity watch file, and notes that the watching can start accounted for.

processes:task-pv-operate-verify-amgq9g.plain_language_name: Test the Arriving Catalogue and Channel States Before Watching
processes:task-pv-operate-verify-amgq9g.plain_language_description: Before the integrity posture can be worked out, the arriving states are put to the test. The verification custodian tests the arriving material against what the activity requires. Shortfalls are written down, either for rejection or for putting right.
processes:task-pv-operate-verify-amgq9g.business_purpose: It stands between logging and the watch itself so a flawed catalogue state never gets scored as if it were sound.
processes:task-pv-operate-verify-amgq9g.practical_context: It opens once the intake is registered and the states are ready to be challenged, and it closes with each shortfall marked for rejection or queued for putting right.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in product management takes the freshly logged catalogue state, checks it against what the integrity watch demands of a usable input, and writes up a missing channel feed as a shortfall to be put right.

processes:task-pv-operate-transform-kev8.plain_language_name: Work Out the Catalogue Integrity Posture
processes:task-pv-operate-transform-kev8.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the watching proper begins. The processing custodian reads the catalogue state and the channel states together, producing the integrity posture in the form the activity's definition specifies. The working papers are kept for the audit trail.
processes:task-pv-operate-transform-kev8.business_purpose: It exists because catalogue correctness only becomes manageable once accuracy, availability and consistency are scored into one stated posture.
processes:task-pv-operate-transform-kev8.practical_context: It opens when the verified states are ready to be worked, and it closes with the integrity posture produced in the agreed form and the workings filed.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in product management weighs the verified catalogue state against each selling channel's state, notes where offerings are mispriced or missing, and states the resulting integrity posture with the workings kept for the audit trail.

processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-pvtsre.plain_language_name: Hand the Integrity Posture to the Teams That Act on It
processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-pvtsre.plain_language_description: The confirming opens once the posture is worked and ready to hand on. The confirmation custodian tells the downstream teams the integrity posture is available, and closes the reconciliation against what the activity promised for the watch.
processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-pvtsre.business_purpose: It exists so decisions about fixing the catalogue rest on a posture that has been formally issued rather than on an unconfirmed draft.
processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-pvtsre.practical_context: It opens when the posture is worked and ready to hand on, and it closes with the confirmation issued and the watch's promises checked off against what was delivered.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian in product management releases the finished integrity posture to the catalogue and channel teams, checks it against what the activity set out to deliver, and closes the reconciliation for the cycle.

processes:task-pv-operate-intake-d4hvkq.plain_language_name: Take In the Catalogue and the Channel Setups for Publishing
processes:task-pv-operate-intake-d4hvkq.plain_language_description: The publishing opens as its material arrives: the maintained catalogue together with the setups that govern each selling channel. The intake custodian logs them against the publishing file so the publishing starts accounted for.
processes:task-pv-operate-intake-d4hvkq.business_purpose: It exists so the push to the channels starts from a logged, attributable set of catalogue and channel material rather than from loose files.
processes:task-pv-operate-intake-d4hvkq.practical_context: It opens when the maintained catalogue and the channel setups are presented for publishing, with the activity's owner told that it has landed, and it closes with the intake registered and the later phases free to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in product management receives the updated catalogue for the season and the setups for the web and shop-front channels, logging both against the publishing file before any channel is touched.

processes:task-pv-operate-verify-9myq93.plain_language_name: Test the Catalogue and Channel Setups Before Pushing Them Out
processes:task-pv-operate-verify-9myq93.plain_language_description: Before anything reaches a selling channel, the arriving catalogue and setups are put to the test. The verification custodian tests the arriving material against what the activity requires. Shortfalls are written down, either for rejection or for putting right.
processes:task-pv-operate-verify-9myq93.business_purpose: It exists to stop a faulty catalogue or a wrong channel setup from being published to the places where customers buy.
processes:task-pv-operate-verify-9myq93.practical_context: It opens once the intake is registered and the publishing material is ready to be challenged, and it closes with every shortfall written down for rejection or putting right.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in product management checks the logged catalogue against each channel's setup requirements, and records an incomplete shop-front configuration as a shortfall to be put right before publishing.

processes:task-pv-operate-transform-hdjy.plain_language_name: Push the Catalogue Out to Each Selling Channel
processes:task-pv-operate-transform-hdjy.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the publishing proper begins. The processing custodian carries the maintained catalogue to each channel under its setup, producing the published catalogue state per channel in the form the activity's definition specifies. The working papers are kept for the audit trail.
processes:task-pv-operate-transform-hdjy.business_purpose: It exists because customers buy through the channels, so the maintained catalogue only earns its keep once it is live in every one of them.
processes:task-pv-operate-transform-hdjy.practical_context: It opens when the verified material is ready to be worked, and it closes with the published state for each channel produced in the agreed form and the workings retained.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in product management publishes the verified catalogue to the web shop and the shop-front channel under their setups, records the resulting published state per channel, and keeps the publish workings for the audit trail.

processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-wnx2ba.plain_language_name: Confirm the Channel Publishing and Tell the Downstream Teams
processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-wnx2ba.plain_language_description: The confirming opens once the catalogue is live in the channels. The confirmation custodian tells the downstream teams the published state is available, and closes the reconciliation against what the activity promised for the push.
processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-wnx2ba.business_purpose: It exists so everyone who trades on the catalogue knows the channel publishing is complete and official rather than still in progress.
processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-wnx2ba.practical_context: It opens when the published states are complete and ready to hand on, and it closes with the confirmation issued and the publishing's promises checked off against what was delivered.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian in product management announces to the sales and support teams that the catalogue is live in every channel, checks the delivered published states against what the publishing promised, and issues the confirmation.

processes:task-pv-operate-record-rsuuq2.plain_language_name: File the Publishing Evidence for the Channels
processes:task-pv-operate-record-rsuuq2.plain_language_description: The filing work opens once confirmation is given. The records custodian preserves the audit record at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so the evidence of what was published to each channel can be found again when a dispute or an audit calls for it.
processes:task-pv-operate-record-rsuuq2.business_purpose: It exists so the organisation can prove, channel by channel, exactly what catalogue state was published and when.
processes:task-pv-operate-record-rsuuq2.practical_context: It opens when the confirmation is in place, and it closes with the publishing evidence filed at its required tier and the retrieval handles set.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian in product management files the channel publishing evidence at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so a pricing query three months later can be answered straight from the record.

processes:task-pv-retire-intake-4ncf7j.plain_language_name: Take In the Withdrawn Service and Its Routed Residuals for Closure
processes:task-pv-retire-intake-4ncf7j.plain_language_description: The closure work opens as its material arrives: the withdrawn service together with the residual obligations already routed from the withdrawal. The intake custodian logs them against the closure file so the confirming starts accounted for.
processes:task-pv-retire-intake-4ncf7j.business_purpose: It exists so retirement closure is confirmed only over a logged withdrawn service and routed residuals, never over loose assertions that a product has gone.
processes:task-pv-retire-intake-4ncf7j.practical_context: It opens when the withdrawn service and its routed residuals are presented for closure, with the activity's owner told that it has landed, and it closes with the intake registered and the later phases free to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the proposition design authority logs the newly withdrawn service and the routed warranty and data-retention residuals into the closure file, so the closure confirmation starts accounted for.

processes:task-pv-retire-verify-nvwtvj.plain_language_name: Test the Withdrawal Material Before Closure Is Confirmed
processes:task-pv-retire-verify-nvwtvj.plain_language_description: Before any closure is declared, the arriving withdrawn-service material is put to the test. The verification custodian tests the arriving material against what the activity requires. Shortfalls are written down, either for rejection or for putting right.
processes:task-pv-retire-verify-nvwtvj.business_purpose: It exists so a retirement is never closed on the strength of material that would not stand up to challenge.
processes:task-pv-retire-verify-nvwtvj.practical_context: It opens once the intake is registered and the closure material is ready to be challenged, and it closes with each shortfall written down for rejection or putting right.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in the proposition design authority challenges the logged closure material against what the activity requires, and writes up an unrouted support commitment as a shortfall to be put right.

processes:task-pv-retire-transform-vhbka.plain_language_name: Draw the Retirement Closure Together with Its Evidence
processes:task-pv-retire-transform-vhbka.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the closure proper begins. The processing custodian gathers the evidence that the service is gone and the residuals are routed, completing the archive and the catalogue de-listing, and produces the retirement closure record in the form the activity's definition specifies. The working papers are kept for the audit trail.
processes:task-pv-retire-transform-vhbka.business_purpose: It exists because a retirement is only truly finished when its evidence, archive and catalogue de-listing are gathered into one closure record.
processes:task-pv-retire-transform-vhbka.practical_context: It opens when the verified closure material is ready to be worked, and it closes with the retirement closure record produced in the agreed form and the workings filed.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the proposition design authority works the verified material into the closure record, completing the archive of the withdrawn service and the de-listing from the catalogue, and keeps the workings for the audit trail.

processes:task-pv-retire-confirm-bpwkag.plain_language_name: Issue the Retirement Closure to the Teams Still Holding Residuals
processes:task-pv-retire-confirm-bpwkag.plain_language_description: The confirming opens once the closure record stands. The confirmation custodian tells the downstream teams the closure is available, and closes the reconciliation against what the activity promised for the retirement.
processes:task-pv-retire-confirm-bpwkag.business_purpose: It exists so support, archive and catalogue teams all hear one authoritative word that the retirement is closed, not rumour.
processes:task-pv-retire-confirm-bpwkag.practical_context: It opens when the closure record is complete and ready to hand on, and it closes with the confirmation issued and the closure's promises checked off against what was delivered.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian in the proposition design authority issues the closure confirmation to the support and catalogue teams, reconciles what was delivered against what the retirement promised, and closes the matter.

processes:task-pv-retire-record-t5vcxv.plain_language_description: The filing work opens once confirmation is given. The records custodian preserves the audit record at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so the proof that this offering was retired cleanly can be produced years later when a warranty or a data-retention question resurfaces.
processes:task-pv-retire-record-t5vcxv.business_purpose: It exists so the closed retirement leaves behind retrievable evidence rather than a silence that later obligation questions cannot be answered from.
processes:task-pv-retire-record-t5vcxv.practical_context: It opens when the confirmation is in place, and it closes with the closure evidence filed at its required tier and the retrieval handles set.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian in the proposition design authority files the retirement closure evidence at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so a customer warranty claim two years on can be checked against the record.

processes:task-pv-retire-intake-s2nuvm.plain_language_name: Take In the Withdrawal Plan for Execution
processes:task-pv-retire-intake-s2nuvm.plain_language_description: The withdrawing opens as its material arrives: the service withdrawal plan that says how the proposition comes out of operational reliance. The intake custodian logs it against the withdrawal file so the executing starts accounted for.
processes:task-pv-retire-intake-s2nuvm.business_purpose: It exists so the removal of a live service starts from one logged plan rather than from verbal instructions drifting across teams.
processes:task-pv-retire-intake-s2nuvm.practical_context: It opens when the withdrawal plan is presented for execution, with the activity's owner told that it has landed, and it closes with the intake registered and the later phases free to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the proposition design authority receives the approved withdrawal plan for a sunset offering, logs it into the withdrawal file, and signals that the removal work can start accounted for.

processes:task-pv-retire-verify-5rh4c6.plain_language_name: Test the Withdrawal Plan Before Any Service Is Removed
processes:task-pv-retire-verify-5rh4c6.plain_language_description: Before anything is switched off, the arriving plan is put to the test. The verification custodian tests the arriving material against what the activity requires. Shortfalls are written down, either for rejection or for putting right.
processes:task-pv-retire-verify-5rh4c6.business_purpose: It exists because executing an inadequate withdrawal plan risks pulling the proposition out from under customers who still rely on it.
processes:task-pv-retire-verify-5rh4c6.practical_context: It opens once the intake is registered and the plan is ready to be challenged, and it closes with the plan's shortfalls written down for rejection or putting right.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in the proposition design authority tests the withdrawal plan against what the activity requires, and flags a missing user-migration step as a shortfall to be put right before any service is switched off.

processes:task-pv-retire-transform-4rw7p.plain_language_name: Carry Out the Withdrawal and Take the Service Out of Reliance
processes:task-pv-retire-transform-4rw7p.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the withdrawal proper begins. The processing custodian works the plan step by step, removing the proposition from operational reliance and producing the withdrawn service in the form the activity's definition specifies. The working papers are kept for the audit trail.
processes:task-pv-retire-transform-4rw7p.business_purpose: It exists because a retirement decision stays on paper until someone actually takes the service out of operational reliance.
processes:task-pv-retire-transform-4rw7p.practical_context: It opens when the verified plan is ready to be worked, and it closes with the withdrawn service produced in the agreed form and the workings retained.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the proposition design authority executes the verified plan, switching off the offering's operational reliance step by step, and hands over the withdrawn service with the workings kept for the audit trail.

processes:task-pv-retire-confirm-hk8w59.plain_language_name: Confirm the Withdrawal Is Done and Tell the Downstream Teams
processes:task-pv-retire-confirm-hk8w59.plain_language_description: The confirming opens once the service is out of reliance. The confirmation custodian tells the downstream teams the withdrawn service is available, and closes the reconciliation against what the activity promised for the withdrawal.
processes:task-pv-retire-confirm-hk8w59.business_purpose: It exists so the residual-obligations and closure teams work from a confirmed withdrawal, not from the assumption that the switch-off went through.
processes:task-pv-retire-confirm-hk8w59.practical_context: It opens when the withdrawn service is ready to hand on, and it closes with the confirmation issued and the withdrawal's promises checked off against what was delivered.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian in the proposition design authority announces the completed withdrawal to the teams handling residuals, reconciles the delivered withdrawn service against the plan's promises, and issues the confirmation.

processes:task-pv-retire-record-tgepzj.plain_language_description: The filing work opens once confirmation is given. The records custodian preserves the audit record at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so what was switched off, when, and under which plan stays provable long after the offering is gone.
processes:task-pv-retire-record-tgepzj.business_purpose: It exists so the execution of a withdrawal leaves evidence that survives staff turnover and later disputes about what was switched off.
processes:task-pv-retire-record-tgepzj.practical_context: It opens when the confirmation is in place, and it closes with the withdrawal evidence filed at its required tier and the retrieval handles set.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian in the proposition design authority files the withdrawal execution evidence at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so a later question about the switch-off date is answered from the record.

processes:task-pv-retire-intake-ygn79u.plain_language_name: Take In the Approved Retirement Decision for Withdrawal Planning
processes:task-pv-retire-intake-ygn79u.plain_language_description: The planning opens as its material arrives: the approved retirement decision that sets the withdrawal in motion. The intake custodian logs it against the withdrawal planning file so the planning starts accounted for.
processes:task-pv-retire-intake-ygn79u.business_purpose: It exists so the plan is drawn from a logged, approved decision rather than from an informal expectation that a product will be retired.
processes:task-pv-retire-intake-ygn79u.practical_context: It opens when the approved retirement decision is presented for planning, with the activity's owner told that it has landed, and it closes with the intake registered and the later phases free to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the proposition design authority logs the approved retirement decision for an ageing service into the planning file, so the withdrawal planning starts accounted for.

processes:task-pv-retire-verify-fx66gf.plain_language_name: Test the Approved Decision Before Planning the Withdrawal
processes:task-pv-retire-verify-fx66gf.plain_language_description: Before notice periods and migration steps are planned, the arriving decision material is put to the test. The verification custodian tests the arriving material against what the activity requires. Shortfalls are written down, either for rejection or for putting right.
processes:task-pv-retire-verify-fx66gf.business_purpose: It exists so the withdrawal plan is never built on a decision that is incomplete or not actually approved.
processes:task-pv-retire-verify-fx66gf.practical_context: It opens once the intake is registered and the decision material is ready to be challenged, and it closes with its shortfalls written down for rejection or putting right.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in the proposition design authority tests the logged retirement decision against what the activity requires, and writes up a missing dependency inventory as a shortfall to be put right.

processes:task-pv-retire-transform-d7ekw.plain_language_name: Draw Up the Withdrawal Plan with Notice, Timelines and Migration
processes:task-pv-retire-transform-d7ekw.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the planning proper begins. The processing custodian works out notice, dependencies, timelines and user migration provisions, producing the service withdrawal plan in the form the activity's definition specifies. The working papers are kept for the audit trail.
processes:task-pv-retire-transform-d7ekw.business_purpose: It exists because retiring a service safely needs one written plan covering who is told, what depends on it, and how users move off.
processes:task-pv-retire-transform-d7ekw.practical_context: It opens when the verified decision material is ready to be worked, and it closes with the withdrawal plan produced in the agreed form and the workings filed.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the proposition design authority drafts the withdrawal plan, setting the customer notice, the dependency timeline and the user migration provisions, and keeps the planning workings for the audit trail.

processes:task-pv-retire-confirm-h2ahnu.plain_language_name: Issue the Withdrawal Plan to the Teams Who Will Execute It
processes:task-pv-retire-confirm-h2ahnu.plain_language_description: The confirming opens once the plan stands. The confirmation custodian tells the downstream teams the plan is available, and closes the reconciliation against what the activity promised for the planning.
processes:task-pv-retire-confirm-h2ahnu.business_purpose: It exists so execution starts from an issued plan everyone can point to, not from a draft circulating by email.
processes:task-pv-retire-confirm-h2ahnu.practical_context: It opens when the plan is complete and ready to hand on, and it closes with the confirmation issued and the planning's promises checked off against what was delivered.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian in the proposition design authority hands the finished withdrawal plan to the execution and communications teams, checks it against what the planning promised, and issues the confirmation.

processes:task-pv-retire-record-ummykz.plain_language_description: The filing work opens once confirmation is given. The records custodian preserves the audit record at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so the reasoning behind notice periods, timelines and migration choices stays retrievable when the withdrawal is later questioned.
processes:task-pv-retire-record-ummykz.business_purpose: It exists so the choices baked into the withdrawal plan can be explained from evidence, not from memory.
processes:task-pv-retire-record-ummykz.practical_context: It opens when the confirmation is in place, and it closes with the planning evidence filed at its required tier and the retrieval handles set.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian in the proposition design authority files the planning evidence at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so a later dispute about the chosen notice period is settled from the record.

processes:task-pv-retire-intake-3j8mds.plain_language_name: Take In the Withdrawn Service and Its Outstanding Commitments
processes:task-pv-retire-intake-3j8mds.plain_language_description: The residual work opens as its material arrives: the withdrawn service together with the commitments it still carries. The intake custodian logs them against the residuals file so the resolving starts accounted for.
processes:task-pv-retire-intake-3j8mds.business_purpose: It exists so no warranty, support commitment or retention duty survives the withdrawal unlogged and therefore unhandled.
processes:task-pv-retire-intake-3j8mds.practical_context: It opens when the withdrawn service and its outstanding commitments are presented for resolution, with the activity's owner told that it has landed, and it closes with the intake registered and the later phases free to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the proposition design authority logs the withdrawn service alongside its outstanding warranty and support commitments into the residuals file, so the resolving starts accounted for.

processes:task-pv-retire-verify-wzs534.plain_language_name: Test the Outstanding Commitments Before Routing Any of Them
processes:task-pv-retire-verify-wzs534.plain_language_description: Before a single obligation is routed, the arriving commitments material is put to the test. The verification custodian tests the arriving material against what the activity requires. Shortfalls are written down, either for rejection or for putting right.
processes:task-pv-retire-verify-wzs534.business_purpose: It exists because a misread commitment routed to the wrong team leaves a customer promise quietly broken.
processes:task-pv-retire-verify-wzs534.practical_context: It opens once the intake is registered and the commitments material is ready to be challenged, and it closes with its shortfalls written down for rejection or putting right.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in the proposition design authority tests the logged commitments against what the activity requires, and writes up an undocumented data-retention duty as a shortfall to be put right.

processes:task-pv-retire-transform-p2ny7.plain_language_name: Identify and Route the Warranties, Support and Retention Duties
processes:task-pv-retire-transform-p2ny7.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the resolving proper begins. The processing custodian identifies each warranty, support commitment and data retention duty and sends it to its owning team, producing the routed residual obligations in the form the activity's definition specifies. The working papers are kept for the audit trail.
processes:task-pv-retire-transform-p2ny7.business_purpose: It exists because retiring the offering does not retire the promises made with it; each one must be identified and given an owner.
processes:task-pv-retire-transform-p2ny7.practical_context: It opens when the verified commitments are ready to be worked, and it closes with the identified and routed obligations produced in the agreed form and the workings filed.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the proposition design authority works through the verified commitments, routing the outstanding warranties to support and the retention duties to records management, and keeps the routing workings for the audit trail.

processes:task-pv-retire-confirm-emnknh.plain_language_name: Tell the Owning Teams Their Residual Duties Have Landed
processes:task-pv-retire-confirm-emnknh.plain_language_description: The confirming opens once the obligations are routed. The confirmation custodian tells the downstream teams the routed residuals are available, and closes the reconciliation against what the activity promised for the resolution.
processes:task-pv-retire-confirm-emnknh.business_purpose: It exists so each owning team formally knows it now holds a duty for a retired offering, instead of discovering it when a claim arrives.
processes:task-pv-retire-confirm-emnknh.practical_context: It opens when the routed obligations are ready to hand on, and it closes with the confirmation issued and the resolution's promises checked off against what was delivered.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian in the proposition design authority notifies support and records management that their routed duties are on record, reconciles the routing against what the resolution promised, and issues the confirmation.

processes:task-pv-retire-record-b7bzyg.plain_language_name: File the Residual Obligations Routing Evidence
processes:task-pv-retire-record-b7bzyg.plain_language_description: The filing work opens once confirmation is given. The records custodian preserves the audit record at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so who holds which duty for the retired offering is answerable from evidence whenever a claim surfaces.
processes:task-pv-retire-record-b7bzyg.business_purpose: It exists so the routing of promises made with a retired offering is provable when a customer or an auditor asks who now owns them.
processes:task-pv-retire-record-b7bzyg.practical_context: It opens when the confirmation is in place, and it closes with the routing evidence filed at its required tier and the retrieval handles set.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian in the proposition design authority files the routing evidence at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so a warranty claim years later is traced to its owning team from the record.

processes:task-sd-activate-intake-armkwz.plain_language_name: Take In the Acknowledged Plan and the Disclosure Framework
processes:task-sd-activate-intake-armkwz.plain_language_description: The communications activation opens as its material arrives: the supervisor-acknowledged strategic plan together with the regulator-mandated disclosure framework. The intake custodian logs them against the activation file so the activating starts accounted for.
processes:task-sd-activate-intake-armkwz.business_purpose: It exists so communications are activated only over a logged acknowledged plan and the mandated framework, under the regulator's continuing supervision.
processes:task-sd-activate-intake-armkwz.practical_context: It opens when the acknowledged plan and the disclosure framework are presented for activation, with the activity's owner told that it has landed, and it closes with the intake registered and the later phases free to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the strategy function logs the supervisor-acknowledged strategic plan and the mandated disclosure framework into the activation file, so the communications work starts accounted for under the regulator's continuing supervision.

processes:task-sd-activate-verify-f85f9w.plain_language_name: Test the Plan and Disclosure Material Before Activating Communications
processes:task-sd-activate-verify-f85f9w.plain_language_description: Before any announcement is made under supervision, the arriving material is put to the test. The verification custodian tests the arriving material against what the activity requires. Shortfalls are written down, either for rejection or for putting right.
processes:task-sd-activate-verify-f85f9w.business_purpose: It exists because announcing under a regulator's continuing supervision on faulty material invites supervisory findings.
processes:task-sd-activate-verify-f85f9w.practical_context: It opens once the intake is registered and the activation material is ready to be challenged, and it closes with its shortfalls written down for rejection or putting right.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in the strategy function tests the logged plan and disclosure framework against what the activity requires, and writes up an outdated disclosure control as a shortfall to be put right before any announcement.

processes:task-sd-activate-transform-df3.plain_language_name: Bring the Disclosure Controls, Briefings and Announcements to Life
processes:task-sd-activate-transform-df3.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the activation proper begins. The processing custodian stands up the disclosure controls, the investor-relations briefing and the regulated-entity announcement under the mandated framework, producing the activated communications plan in the form the activity's definition specifies. The working papers are kept for the audit trail.
